structured_output.summary: The remote-delivery chunk's four delivery receipts are real and cross-verified: registry bytes (533294fe…, re-downloaded by the executed portable route), identical annotated v0.2.4 tag objects on canonical and GitHub at published commit 6f18529, and 49/49 terminal successful CI contexts for run 31 with the run-30 failure preserved in both run histories. tools/postdelivery.py enforces byte-exact published-payload equivalence with a narrow governance allowlist, byte-bounded AGENTS/ci.yml edits, producer binding, and an allowlist-equals-executed-suites test; 165 focused tests with substantive negative cases passed. All three attempt-4 findings are implemented and machine-verified. Remaining: the governance CI route has no remote run while docs claim present-tense execution; the external qualified root is not independently inspectable.

findings.description: "CI now executes the Phase 28 contracts gate in post-publication governance mode" is stated in the present tense, but remote main is 56a88d2, whose ci.yml is the pre-governance route (its fingerprint equals the published QUALIFIED hash). The governance workflow has only host-local evidence (docs/checks/phase-28-postdelivery-contracts.json); no remote run has executed it. docs/post-publication-governance.md:74-80 likewise describes CI behaviour without that disclosure.
findings.required_fix: State explicitly in docs/CI.md and docs/post-publication-governance.md that run 31 executed the published-source contracts route and that the governance-mode route currently has host-local execution evidence only, with no terminal remote run.

findings.description: verify_tag_observations resolves the fresh observation path through evidence()/containment checks but reads the original receipt as read(root / phase['delivery'][original_field]) with no containment or prefix validation. docs/phase-status.json is excluded from the fingerprint and from immutable_inventory, so this pointer is unbound source, inconsistent with test_evidence_paths_cannot_escape_checkout.
findings.required_fix: Route the original tag-receipt path through evidence(root, ...) as well, and add a negative case for an escaping original_field value.

findings.description: Module docstring still reads "Retain read-only remote tag and terminal Forgejo CI observations for phase 24" although this producer is now the registered phase-28 governance observer (bound by observerSha256 in phase-status release_preflight).
findings.required_fix: Update the docstring to cover the phase-24 and phase-28/0.2.4 governance observation modes.

findings.description: The --post-publication-governance argument validation (phase!=28, --resume, host vs portable mode combinations) has no direct regression; test_ci.py only asserts the workflow invocation string and governance command inventory. Every other mutable GOVERNANCE_PATHS entry has an executed suite.
findings.required_fix: Add a focused test in tools/test_postdelivery.py exercising the rejected argument combinations and both accepted modes of check_phase.main.

findings.description: verify_readiness_disposition packs ~17 equality terms into one boolean if, so a failure yields a single generic message and the intent is hard to audit; the same style appears in verify_tag_observations and verify_prior_failure.
findings.required_fix: Split into named per-field comparisons (or a (field, expected) table) so each rejection reports which binding differed.

findings.description: GOVERNANCE_PATHS permits unrestricted edits to docs/PHASES.md, the document defining phase-28 acceptance, whereas AGENTS.md and .forgejo/workflows/ci.yml are byte-bounded to an exact diff. Only selected mirror-disclosure phrases are pinned by test_release_024.test_public_readme_and_delivery_governing_contract.
findings.required_fix: Pin the phase-28 acceptance paragraph (both named chunks, 46/50, every-category-8, 49 CI contexts) in a regression so post-publication governance edits cannot weaken the acceptance contract.

evidence: docs/reviews/phase-28-chunk-remote-delivery-attempt-05.checks.json:79-207 records 8 executed checks, all exit_code 0: test_postdelivery (23 tests), test_final_delivery_review (6), test_release_delivery (14), test_review_phase (52), test_release_023 (12), test_release_024 (18), test_ci (40), plus tools/release_delivery.py --post-publication-governance returning passed=true with jobs=49; source_unchanged true at 225696bd…

docs/checks/phase-28-remote-ci-run-31-observation-05.json:2667-2675 shows expectedJobCount 49, counts {"success": 49}, contextsMatchConfiguredMatrix true; runHistory (1144-1157) retains run 30 failure and run 31 success on the same commit 56a88d2; a full confirmation snapshot (1162+) and observation window 19:02:53-19:02:55 are recorded.

docs/checks/release-tag-github-v0.2.4-observation-05.json:3-11 binds remote https://github.com/cdot65/scm-sdk-rs.git, tag v0.2.4, tagObject 2f7ad298…, peeled ref to 6f18529…, producer scripts/observe-release.py with observerSha256 a1c1383c… and governanceSourceSha256 225696bd…; checkedAt 19:02:52 postdates registry publishedAt 17:49:15 (release-registry-0.2.4.json:7).

tools/release_delivery.py:73-126 validate_receipts requires both compiler proofs to qualify identical files/source, registry identity/ownership/yanked=false, annotated tag object plus peeled ref equal to the published commit, exact context-set equality with the workflow matrix, per-job terminal success, unique job URLs, and summary agreement; verify_source_commits re-fingerprints both the published and CI commits against the reviewed source.

tools/release_delivery.py:190-208 verify_github_tag requires the 0.2.4 mirror receipt to match the canonical tag, tagObject and sourceCommit exactly — the fourth delivery receipt mandated by docs/PHASES.md:306-309.

tools/postdelivery.py:68-114 immutable_inventory recomputes every blob id and mode against published tree 6f18529, rejects new/removed/symlinked payload files, and limits AGENTS.md to one exact clause replacement and ci.yml to the exact contracts route/report rename; docs/checks/phase-28-postdelivery.json:5-7 reports publishedInventorySha256 8686c1b6… at governance source 225696bd….

tools/postdelivery.py:124-157 verify_readiness_disposition machine-checks the rejected readiness attempt-5 record (decision rejected, total 39, pinned review/checks digests, original source 2a2984e3…) and the retained 105-command SDK qualification; tools/test_postdelivery.py:330-369 exercises it against the real artifacts with five field-tamper cases and byte-append cases on all referenced files — implementing attempt-4 finding 3.

docs/CI.md:111-115 now documents the governance contracts-and-package job (7 focused suites, retained host report, public registry archive download, phase-28-postdelivery-contracts.json) and test_ci.py:144-170 derives the documented inventory from postdelivery.commands_for when the workflow selects --post-publication-governance — implementing attempt-4 finding 1.

docs/phase-status.json:9138-9148 records remote_delivery_attempt_3 as rejected at 41, and 9185 marks the attempt-4 acceptance accepted_at_source_536dad68_now_superseded_by_followup_source_changes — implementing attempt-4 finding 2; review_phase.py:450-468 independently requires the latest chunk review to cover current declared scope and be accepted.

tools/test_ci.py:46-142 executes the real qualify_portable producer and the verbatim workflow heredoc in bash, asserting the logged phase/source_sha256/source_unchanged/passed fields and KeyError failures for each omitted key — the attempt-3 rejection cause is closed.

scripts/observe-release.py:196-272 reads the Forgejo token only from the environment, never writes it to receipts, bounds pagination to 20 pages of 50 with an 8 MiB response cap and no-redirect opener, captures two snapshots plus two run histories and requires them to agree, and selects per-context max(created_at,id) with conflict detection (92-109); write() uses mode 'x' so receipts cannot be overwritten.

tools/postdelivery.py:419-427 verify_portable downloads https://static.crates.io/crates/scm-sdk/scm-sdk-0.2.4.crate with a 32 MiB bound and no redirects and compares bytes/digest to the registry receipt; docs/checks/phase-28-postdelivery-contracts.json:8 records registryArchiveSha256 533294fe…, matching release-registry-0.2.4.json:12.

tools/postdelivery.py:507-519 (test_mutable_test_allowlist_matches_executed_suites) requires the mutable tools/test_* governance allowlist to equal the executed suite set, so every post-publication-mutable test file is actually run; scope files such as scripts/check-package.py and tools/test_package_policy.py are outside GOVERNANCE_PATHS and therefore proven byte-identical to the 105-command-qualified published source.

review_phase.py:67-105 validate_final_delivery_authorization verifies the exact maintainer grant (question call id call_1601a73a…, answer, maxFreshReviews 5) in docs/reviews/recovery-authorizations/2026-10-22.json:22-35 and pins the digest of all 20 original readiness artifacts before the separate phase-28-final-delivery namespace may be used; gate_decision:108-125 implements the attempt-5 >40 exception with blocker/high still blocking.
limitations: The canonical qualified checkout /home/cdot/development/cdot65/scm-sdk-rs-ts035 is outside this repository and was not read per the review constraints; its 105-command qualification, both compiler package proofs, retained archives and the re-executed delivery guard are attested only by the recorded receipt docs/checks/phase-28-composed-delivery-F.json and the hash bindings in the governance report.
No commands were executed and no network calls were made: all check results, including the registry archive download in the portable route, are read from recorded receipts rather than re-run.

Remote state (Forgejo run 31, both annotated tags, crates.io) was not contacted; CI and tag evidence are point-in-time observations, and the observer's per-context latest-status rule assumes Forgejo status ids increase with time — a limitation the project discloses in docs/post-publication-governance.md:59-62.

Phase completion remains blocked outside this chunk: the release-readiness chunk's fifth review was rejected at 39/50 with its budget exhausted and recovery authorization still pending (docs/phase-status.json:9150-9157, 9188-9197). This is correctly recorded and is not a defect of the remote-delivery chunk, but docs/PHASES.md:291-303 requires both chunks before the phase can complete.
Directional-profile live service acceptance remains explicitly unverified, and the documentation site deployment is separate; neither was in this chunk's scope.
